You should be capable of working with our third-party vendors, both independently and in a team environment as needed, to provide best-in-class customer service for our internal and external customers. Additionally, you will be exposed to and expected to contribute to key billing functions within independent and cross-functional team projects. You should be capable of working with our third-party vendors, both independently and in a team environment as needed, to provide best-in-class customer service for our internal and external customers. This role is based in [Location masked], and reports to the Billing Resolutions Manager.
cond_0291.responsibilities: Review and provide instructions to the billing vendor for accurate billing and payment application. Manage customers on prepayment arrangements, calculating billed amounts and reconciling account balances for proper credit assurance. Follow the Sales Tax-Exempt Process, including reviewing certificates, facilitating audit requests from the tax department, and determining if refunds are necessary. Execute internal controls, between billing and shadow settlement systems and analyzes variances and process refunds as needed. High degree of reliability, strong ethics, and ability to work productively with fast turnaround.

Experience as an independent thinker across multiple markets.
Proficiency in SQL, macros, and MS Access.
Proficiency in multiple data systems and advanced PC skills, including MS Office Suite.

Execute internal controls between billing and shadow settlement systems, analyze variances, and process refunds as needed.
Research and correct discrepancies between the internal data warehouse and external billing system.
Provide cross-functional support to develop end-to-end delivery processes, regularly connecting with team members to clarify requirements and keep work moving.

Strong, extensive knowledge of retail energy operations, procedures, and regulatory standards, with direct billing experience.
An independent thinker with experience in multiple markets and proficiency in SQL, macros, and MS Access.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills — you are comfortable explaining issues clearly, handling questions, and following up with stakeholders across teams.
Detail-oriented with strong follow-up skills and a high degree of reliability.
Strong ethics and productive, efficient work habits with quick turnarounds.
Proficient in using multiple data systems, with advanced PC skills including MS Office Suite.
